title: barracks_bathroom
hook: My roommate came back to the barracks drunk and destroyed the bathroom. Cleaning it was literally my job.
beats: My roommate came back to the barracks drunk and destroyed the bathroom. Cleaning it was literally my job.
It was a Friday night. I heard him stumble in around 2 a.m., singing to himself.
Then I heard the bathroom door slam. Then sounds I will never, ever forget.
In the morning, I opened that door and genuinely thought a crime scene unit should be called.
It was everywhere. The walls. The door. Places that defy physics. I still don't understand the ceiling.
And here's the thing. That week, bathroom detail was assigned to one person. Me.
He walked past me with a coffee, looked at the bathroom, looked at me, and said, 'Rough night in there, huh?'
So I cleaned it. All of it. Three hours, two bottles of bleach, and one silent vow of revenge.
Because inspection was Monday. And guess whose boots I was NOT going to shine-check before the sergeant walked our room.
He got written up for the boots, the wall locker, and the smell he never noticed on his own uniform.
He asked me why I didn't warn him. I said, 'Rough night in there, huh?'
